mechanics_text: Gamma Shields protect from gamma radiation in the Ginoya system, affected by the supernova.
Without protection, ships take constant damage from radiation in the Ginoya system.
Gamma Shield I provides 40% radiation protection — requires Supernova DLC.
None of the regular shields provide any protection against gamma radiation.
version_notes: Supernova DLC. Gamma radiation protection — effect_pct = percentage of radiation blocked. Regular shields do NOT protect against gamma radiation.
